value.rationale: A single equatorial ring is the cheapest natural longitude-complete spin-two sampler at one degree. Its nullspace has an infinite nonmonotone Pell-indexed arithmetic structure. The theorem classifies all ranks and attainable data and supplies an explicit minimum number of sparse derivative samples to overcome every obstruction; not merely a numerical special case.
